description.value: Prestige Aberdeen Lodge Kamloops is a 39-room lodge property in the Aberdeen area just off the Trans-Canada Highway, part of BC's family-owned Prestige Hotels & Resorts chain. The lodge offers an onsite restaurant, fitness centre, and coin laundry, and guests have access to the indoor pool and waterslide at the adjacent Prestige Kamloops Hotel. A complimentary continental breakfast is included with all stays, making it a practical and comfortable base for cyclists passing through Kamloops.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for Prestige Aberdeen Lodge Kamloops loaded successfully and is the primary evidence source. The amenities list explicitly confirms coin laundry, complimentary continental breakfast, Wi-Fi, and an onsite restaurant. The contact subpage confirms the phone number (250.372.0952 matches OSM's +1-250-372-0952) but shows a different email (aberdeenlodge@PrestigeHotels.ca vs OSM's desk@pacificinnkamloops.com). No mention of bike storage, bike rooms, tools, pump, or e-bike charging anywhere on the site.
